name: commercetools Online Demo
description: Install-only orchestrator that turns a Drupal site into a pre-configured commercetools B2C Lifestyle demo store; all behaviour is in a single hook_install, no routes/controllers/forms.
project_description:
A live online demo of the commercetools Drupal e-commerce module that works directly in the browser without any special setup. This profile automatically deploys a fully functional e-commerce store website with free demo accounts provided by EPAM and commercetools using the Simplytests.me service.

 Launch commercetools demo » 
 
This demo profile is based on the commercetools Drupal module.

 The backend database with products, orders, and other e-commerce related data is provided by EPAM and commercetools .

 You can register a free trial account on the commercetools website and configure it on the demo settings page to test the module with your own products and workflows.

 You can log in to the website as admin by clicking the "Log in" link in the top right corner and entering "admin" for both the username and password.

 This project provides a Drupal installation profile to provide a live demo of the Drupal commercetools module; the actual module is here: Drupal commercetools module .
